scenes.text: Day one of seven: every n8n workflow starts with a trigger.
A trigger is the event that starts everything. The Chat Trigger runs your workflow whenever someone sends a message.
The Schedule Trigger runs on a clock. Choose seconds up to months, or paste a custom cron expression.
The catch: a scheduled workflow only runs once you publish it. Saving alone does nothing.
Testing by hand is a manual execution. Only production runs count toward your plan quota.
Pick the trigger first, then the nodes. Everything else in the workflow depends on how it starts.
Day two adds the AI Agent. Follow so you do not miss it, and comment GUIDE for the PDF.
